outcome: Latency from previable prelabor rupture of membranes diagnosis to delivery
cohort: The study participants were pregnancies with previable prelabor rupture of membranes prior to 23 0/7 weeks, excluding those opting for termination or with contraindications to expectant management.
finding: Antibiotic administration at the time of previable prelabor rupture of membranes was associated with longer latency prior to 22 weeks gestation and increased the odds of delivering after viability.
gest_age: Prior to 23 0/7 weeks at membrane rupture, with subanalysis for those at less than 22 weeks gestation.
